failed_outcomes.reason: The initial preflight record omitted the doctrine-required receipt envelope.

namespace_lookup.result: GitHub could not resolve ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-data because it does not exist.

preconditions: Doctrine revision 6 is merged before repository creation.
The ePC-SAFT/ePC-SAFT-data namespace remains unoccupied at mutation time.
The initial repository contains only the minimal packet contract and admitted packet content.
No package imports from or fetches the Data repository at runtime.
expected_postconditions: The repository is public with main as its default branch.
Management records the repository identity and exact initial commit in a later operation-state receipt.
Canonical packets are self-contained under packets/<packet-id>/<version>/.
EOS runtime copies and Validation evidence pin immutable Data inputs.
record.retry: Repeat the namespace lookup once immediately before creation; stop if the namespace is occupied.
stop_conditions: The namespace resolves to an existing repository.
The requested organization, visibility, or default branch differs from the approved subject.
record.reversibility: Repository contents are reversible through Git. Repository deletion is not authorized; an erroneous creation stops for user direction.
